[[File:Meatlump_graffiti.jpg|thumb|250px|A graffiti created by the [[Meatlumps]]]]
'''Graffiti''' was a type of vandalism, in which a being etched messages on public property. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] led a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to terrorize visitors to [[Hologram Fun World]]; one of their means of driving away the tourists was to etch graffiti on the [[Hologram Fun World Administration Building]] with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].

The [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] also used graffiti to mark their territory.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
